scope: Two prospective dog-spread research leans only. No canonical changes or execution authority.

rows.reason: Current material evidence defeats the earlier offensive applicability assumed in the dog lean. Houser underwent broken-nose surgery and is uncertain after a concussion. Michael Clayton II is unavailable with a throwing-hand injury. Bielema is preparing for Carson Boyd to become the third starting quarterback. Boyd had three unsuccessful attempts against UCLA after only one earlier attempt this year. Illinois is also losing Clement, its second receiver. A defense that has recently held opponents to 20 or fewer offensive points supports staying close, but over a touchdown of protection cannot be treated as an earned advantage when possession sustainability, passing and turnover risk are materially downgraded against Iowa's top-ranked scoring defense.
rows.supporting_case_weighed: The +8.5 protects an eight-point loss, one point more than +7.5 at the same juice. Illinois recent defense and home field support a competitive game. The original near-even projection supplies context only.
rows.strongest_countercase: Iowa allows 11.7 points per game and has efficient recent Brown/Phillips production. A possible third-string Illinois quarterback plus loss of Clement can produce short drives and short fields, eroding the recent defensive mechanism. No calibrated cover estimate was invented.
rows.price_judgment: At -110 the resolved-bet break-even ratio is 52.38%. The number crosses an eight-point margin, but no verified evidence establishes enough cover likelihood under the changed Illinois offensive personnel. No alternative number or price threshold is earned.

rows.reason: Michigan's defense and more than a field goal of protection form a plausible dog mechanism, but the current passing and protection changes defeat the earlier lean at this number. Whittingham's Monday transcript confirms an open Carr/Underwood competition, Sprague unavailable, Frazier probably unavailable, approximately 70 passing yards at Oregon and a minus-ten turnover margin. Original beat reporting of that press conference confirms Buchanan's season-ending shoulder loss. UCLA leads the country in takeaways and its current quarterback returned to play productively after last week's injury. The small +3.5 cushion does not sufficiently compensate for Michigan's diminished ability to sustain drives and avoid extra opponent possessions.
rows.supporting_case_weighed: Michigan allows 17.7 points and 276.5 yards per game, generated 215 rushing yards last game and plays at home. +3.5 protects a field-goal loss and the price is cheaper than -110. Those facts make a credible research watch but fail selection against the current offensive countercase.
rows.strongest_countercase: UCLA's 30 takeaways, Mizell deep-play production and Dieffenbach's productive return threaten an injured, unstable Michigan offense. Whittingham called Oregon the defense's worst outing and acknowledged repeated missed deep shots. UCLA health remains a fact to monitor, without assuming it supplies a Michigan advantage.
rows.price_judgment: At -108 the resolved-bet break-even ratio is 51.92%. The +3.5 clears a field-goal margin but gives little insulation against turnover-created separation. No calibrated cover estimate or exact better-price threshold is supported. No action cap is issued.
